categories.main_business_segments: Winning Health Technology Group primarily operates in the medical and health information technology sector, offering integrated solutions including smart hospital systems, regional health platforms, grassroots health, public health, medical insurance, and health services. The company also develops internet healthcare services and digital health applications under its '1+X' strategy, with '1' representing the WiNEX product series and 'X' representing various digital health application scenarios.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI technologies, including its proprietary medical vertical large model WiNGPT and AI-powered medical assistant WiNEX Copilot, integrated into its WiNEX product line. It employs a unified middle-platform architecture, digital knowledge graphs, intelligent data governance engines, and AI model training frameworks. The company also emphasizes cloud-ready product delivery, low-code/no-code development platforms, and deep integration with domestic IT ecosystems for secure and scalable solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Winning Health serves primarily domestic public hospitals, health management departments, and medical institutions across China, including over 6,000 healthcare institutions and more than 400 tertiary hospitals. Its products and services target the healthcare IT market, including hospital information systems, regional health information platforms, internet hospitals, and medical insurance sectors. The company also has emerging international presence, exemplified by projects in Macau and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering 32 provinces, municipalities, and autonomous regions except Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau. Key regional markets include Shanghai, other East China regions, North China, Central China, and South China. It has begun international expansion with projects in Macau and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Winning Health operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the healthcare IT supply chain, focusing on software development, system integration, and service provision to healthcare institutions. It provides end-to-end digital solutions and ongoing technical support, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a hardware manufacturer or upstream component supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes AI-driven innovation, focusing on medical vertical large models, intelligent clinical assistants, and digital health ecosystems. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 20% of revenue allocated to research, developing next-generation smart medical products and cloud services. The strategic direction includes enhancing AI capabilities, expanding international adaptability, deepening integration with domestic IT ecosystems, and accelerating cloud-based delivery and operation.
categories.revenue_model: Winning Health generates revenue mainly through contracts for information system projects, software sales, and technical service agreements with hospitals and health departments. Revenue streams include project contract payments, software licensing, hardware sales, and ongoing technical support and maintenance services. The company also derives income from internet healthcare services and digital health application scenarios.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's medical health information industry, ranking first in hospital core system market share for four consecutive years with a 13.4% share as of 2023. It competes with other domestic healthcare IT providers but distinguishes itself through comprehensive product lines, strong R&D capabilities, and extensive customer coverage nationwide.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Winning Health reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.78 billion, a 12.05% decrease year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 87.9 million, down 75.45%. Despite revenue decline due to delayed customer demand and product upgrades, the company maintains stable operations with a total asset base of around RMB 8.76 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 5.96 billion. Cash flow from operations improved significantly by 120.53%.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Winning Health emphasizes its integrated, AI-enhanced medical information solutions that improve clinical efficiency, hospital management, and healthcare service quality. Its proprietary AI large model WiNGPT and intelligent assistant WiNEX Copilot provide competitive differentiation by deeply embedding AI into clinical and operational workflows. The company also highlights its comprehensive product ecosystem, extensive customer base, localized service capabilities, and strong alignment with national digital health policies.
